status: GEN/CANDIDATE conditional inverse-problem result; not a physical prediction
question: Does calibrated-zero atomicity survive fourfold-expanded relaxation support?
decision: Interval-robust atomicity fails: central centroids, masses, and median width converge, but the fast-width q975 rebounds at 97 bins and endpoint-mass q975 grows under refinement.
geometric_interpretation: The exact squared-resolvent residue kernel has weak sensitivity at large tau over much of the radius range, so the rare boundary branch is a candidate measurement-null direction rather than evidence for an additional relaxation channel.
failure_condition: A discrete fast channel cannot be claimed interval-robust for this measurement class unless the tail displacement is shown to lie entirely outside the identifiable Jacobian subspace or an independent observable removes it.
next_dependency: Construct the calibration-marginalized whitened joint pole/residue Jacobian on the 97-bin wide grid, perform an SVD, and decompose every tail solution into identifiable and null-space components. Add no constitutive mode.
